definitions.explanation: A bag with insulated lining designed to keep food and drinks cool during transport.

notes:
A compound of {保冷|ほれい} (keeping cool, cold storage) and ⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧ (bag). A practical everyday item in Japan, especially popular during the hot summer months for grocery shopping and outdoor activities.

Many Japanese supermarkets sell or provide {保冷|ほれい}バッグ, and eco-conscious shoppers often bring their own reusable ones. They are also essential for ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ transport in warm weather.
